Package org.example

Class ParserOperation

java.lang.Object
org.example.ParserExpression
org.example.ParserOperation
public class ParserOperation extends ParserExpression
An internal parser token representing an arithmetic operation or a parenthesis delimiter. This class extends ParserExpression and holds metadata required by the Shunting-yard algorithm, such as operator precedence and the specific operator character.

      public ParserOperation(char operand, int priority)
      Constructs a new operation parser token with the specified character and precedence priority. Automatically sets the parent token type classification to ExprType.BinaryOperation.
      Parameters:
      operand - the character symbol of the operation
      priority - the precedence rank of the operation
